name: Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI)
description: An annual index ranking 180 countries by perceived levels of public sector corruption, based on expert assessments and business surveys. Scores 0 (highly corrupt) to 100 (very clean).
reputation: Most widely cited corruption index globally; used by investors, NGOs, and governments.
notes: Measures perception not actual corruption; relies on third-party surveys; sensitive to which surveys are included.
